title: The Rolling Acre Ranch House
description:
Thank you for considering my home! Welcome to a beautiful and spacious ranch house with 4 bedrooms, a work space and a huge kitchen. Convenient to all Nashville's attractions in a beautiful & safe neighborhood!
Boasting hardwood floors, large windows and lots of light, this charming home sits on a rolling green acre of old growth trees in one of Nashville’s safest and most coveted neighborhoods.

The space
You'll wake up in a great mood every day in this beautiful house. The large kitchen is fully equipped and waiting for you to cook a delicious meal. From every window, the peaceful view will remind you of the unique location you chose; both city and nature awaits right outside your door. 

 Included in the Rolling Acre Ranch House: 
*Living room w/  large Roku TV
*2 bedrooms w/ closets, pillow top queen mattresses and their own Roku TV’s. 
* Yoga Room / Home Office Area 
* Very large fully stocked Kitchen
* Dining Nook
* Laundry Room
* Private parking spot(s) for 2 cars
* Community Park and Pool just a 5 minute walk away

You are welcome to enjoy the property! The back yard is host to many colorful birds, from Northern Cardinals to the American Goldfinch. Mornings are a great time to take your coffee out to the patio, sit back and watch all their drama unfold!  In the evenings, watch the sun set from the same spot; painting all the leaves and tree trunks orange. Enjoy a walk or jog? There is a lovely park just steps away.

Driving time to popular destinations are as follows: 
I-65 4 min
Opryland 15 min
Broadway 12-15 min
East Nashville 12-15 min
Popular shopping areas (Rivergate Mall, Target..) 5 minutes
Vanderbilt University is 20 minutes

Guest access
Full access to the entire house!
